verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The five normalizing powers agree entry by entry and in the same order (M, I, J, S, C_p): NominalProfile.dilationFactor R = ![R, R√R, R√R, R, 1], and R√R = R^{3/2} for R > 0, with the fifth entry 1, i.e. C_p unnormalized. The Lean states the inverse of the display: moments_dilate gives m(X) = dilationFactor X_R ∙ m̂(X/X_R) componentwise, which divided through is exactly m̂ = (M/X_R, I/X_R^{3/2}, J/X_R^{3/2}, S/X_R, C_p) at x = X/X_R. The same four powers appear in OutgoingDilation (M_scaling, I_scaling, J_scaling, S_scaling) and the pressure invariance in axisDatum_unchanged. The Lean's X_R is an arbitrary positive R in these lemmas, not the particular 110(CP_*)^10 of Proposition 4.10 (that value is NominalProfile.matchingRadius, NominalProfile.lean:141).
